lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly parallel horizontal and vertical rows across the mid-flank posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal spot rows to form localized grid anchor points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature extending horizontally along the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a highlight on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-saturation green artificial object or tag attached to the dorsal region posterior to the first dorsal fin.
